title: Personal Assistant
description:
Personal Assistant (PA) - Temp to Perm Opportunity based in Truro

Location: Truro / Hybrid Working (Remote & On-Site)
Hours: 4 Days per Week (Fridays Off)
Working Hours: Flexible start and finish time, either 8:00am to 4:00pm or 8:30am to 4:30pm
Pay Rate: 14.85 per hour + Holiday Pay - weekly paid
Contract: Temporary with the opportunity of a permanent position for the right candidate

We are delighted to be recruiting for an organised and proactive Personal Assistant to provide high-level administrative support to a senior leader within a busy and rewarding organisation based in Truro.

This is a varied role that would suit someone who enjoys managing multiple priorities, communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, and supporting projects that make a real difference within the community.

Key Responsibilities:
- Managing and filtering emails, ensuring important communications are prioritised
- Diary management and scheduling appointments, meetings and events
- Liaising and communicating with internal teams and external partners on behalf of senior management
- Coordinating ad hoc tasks and projects across the organisation
- Preparing agendas and taking accurate meeting minutes
- Filing, organising and maintaining records and documentation
- Building and maintaining positive relationships with key stakeholders, including partners
- Supporting wider teams and projects as required

Additional Duties:
- Attending occasional site visits with colleagues
- Providing administrative support to other departments and projects when needed

About You:
- Previous skills as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant or Senior Administrator
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Strong communication and relationship-building abilities
- Ability to work independently and manage a varied workload
- Confident using Microsoft Office and other administrative systems
- Professional, proactive and adaptable approach

What's on Offer:
- Hourly pay rate of 14.85 plus holiday pay
- 4-day working week with Fridays off
- Flexible start and finish times
- Hybrid working available once established in the role, with a minimum of one day per week on-site
- Opportunity to secure a permanent position

If you are looking for your next exciting PA or Administrator role and are looking for a flexible and rewarding opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. Contact Sally Appleby at Berry Recruitment Truro, Cornwall today!

We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. All applicants will be considered on the basis of their skills, experience, qualifications and ability to perform the role, and no applicant will be treated less favourably because of a protected characteristic under the Equality Act 2010.

title: Call Centre Agent
description:
Start Date - 21/09/2026

Shift Pattern - We are offering 20 or 25 Hours, Part-Time Lates
Monday - Friday 16:45 PM to 21:00 PM (We would also be flexiable with an earlier finish at 20:00pm if needed)

20 Hours per Week - Salary: £13,928.53 per year
Plus incentives and bonus opportunities

25 Hours per Week - Salary: £17,410.67 per year
Plus incentives and bonus opportunities

With no weekend working and a schedule designed to fit around your life, this is a great opportunity to build a rewarding career while maintaining the work-life balance that matters most.

Looking for a role that works around family life, childcare, studies or other commitments? Our part-time evening shifts offer the flexibility to keep your days free while enjoying every weekend off.

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Truro team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Truro contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths

Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.

It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.

People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £13,928.53 which goes up to £14,260.27 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.
